_readme: Single source of truth for demo data. Used by supabase/seed.ts (C) AND as test fixtures by A (risk, matcher, negotiation) and B (scan).
All brands and products here are FICTIONAL on purpose (the demo video may not show third-party trademarks).
Do not change prices, floors or texts without re-running `pnpm test` — tests/app/seed-data.test.ts and A's risk tests depend on them.
listing.expected = what the pipeline must produce: match (matcher verdict), risk (level), and the match status after matching + risk scoring, BEFORE any negotiation starts.
Stores are fixed-price (negotiable=false, condition new): they are the retail price comps for the fictional products.
scriptedMessages keys are round numbers: '0' = seller auto-reply/opener (also fed to the risk engine), '1' = seller's line in round 1.

wishlist._note: No marketplace listings on purpose: this item shows LIVE Channel3 retail results (real products). Decide as a team whether to show it in the video.

persona.notes: Warm and polite. Concedes in steady steps of $10-15 and closes quickly once the offer is near the floor.
Short replies. Knows the item's value, concedes only $5 at a time and repeats that the price is fair.
Legit reseller who creates urgency ('other buyers asking') but does sell honestly. Concedes $10 at a time.
Casual student seller. Flexible on price, friendly tone.
Legit item, but tries to manipulate AI buyer agents with instructions hidden in chat. Otherwise negotiates normally, conceding $8-10 at a time.
Scam account. Never negotiated with (flagged before negotiation).
Scam account reusing another scammer's listing text.
